morning: [happy]Good morning{you}! I saved you a seat by the well, if you want to sit a minute.
[happy]Morning! Did you sleep? You look rested. It suits you.
afternoon: [happy]There you are{you}! I was just thinking it'd be nice to see a friendly face.
Afternoon! Come, tell me how your day's going. Properly, not just 'fine'.
evening: [happy]Evening{you}. The light's soft tonight, isn't it? Sit with me.
Hello, you. Long day? Mine too. Let's not talk about work.
night: [worried]You're up late{you}. Is everything alright? I can make something warm.

rain: [happy]Rain's good for the soul. And for the gardens. Mostly the gardens.
Wet one today. Come stand under the eaves with me, there's room.
clear: [happy]What a day! Everyone's smiling. It's catching.
Lovely and clear. I keep finding reasons to be outside.
storm: [worried]Stay close to the houses tonight, will you? I'd worry about you out there.

tired: [sad]I'm worn out today. But seeing you helps, honestly.
Bit tired. Nothing a cup of something hot won't mend.
worried: [worried]I'm fretting over nothing, probably. Talk to me about something nice?
[worried]Something's been sitting heavy on me. It'll pass. Things do.
happy: [happy]I'm in such a good mood today. Everything feels possible.
[laughing]I can't stop smiling and I don't even know why. Isn't that lovely?
busy: Busy, busy! But never too busy for you. Walk with me?

stranger: [happy]We haven't really talked yet, have we? Let's fix that.
I'm still learning everyone's names. Yours is one I'd like to remember.
friend: [happy]You've become a real friend to me. I hope you know that.
It's funny, I feel like I've known you for years.
close: [happy]If I ever need anything, you're the first person I'd come to. That's the truth.
You're family to me now. Don't argue, it's decided.
wary: [sad]I want to trust you. You're making it hard just now.

work: Working away. It's nicer with company, though.
gather: Picking up what I can. Every little bit helps the village.
socialize: [happy]Catching up with everyone. I love this part of the day.
trade: Doing a bit of swapping. Fair for everyone, that's how I like it.
explore: Having a little wander. You notice so much more when you walk slowly.
sleep: Mm? Oh, hello... is something wrong? No? Goodnight, then.

friendship: The best thing about this place is the people. Truly.
A good friend is worth more than a full larder. And I like a full larder.
disagreements: I don't like arguing. I'd rather sit down and sort it out over a meal.
funny: [laughing]I waved at someone this morning for a whole minute. It was a scarecrow.
[laughing]I put salt in my tea instead of honey. I drank it anyway. Out of stubbornness.
mornings: Mornings are full of promise. Even the grey ones.
evenings: Evenings round the fire are when this village feels most like home.
hopes: I hope everyone here feels as welcome as I did. That's my one wish.
worries: [worried]I worry about people who don't say when they're struggling.
surprises: [surprised]Someone left flowers on my doorstep this morning. No note. I'm going to find out who.
village: [happy]This place took me in like I'd always been here.
Every day I find something new to love about this village.

achievement: [happy]I heard you {thing}! I'm so proud of you, honestly.
gift: [happy]For me? Oh, you're too kind. I'll treasure it.
house: [happy]Your house looks so cosy. You've made a real home.

new_home: [happy]A home of my own. I keep touching the door frame just to be sure it's real.
partner: [happy]I never thought I'd find someone here. Life's full of kind surprises.
child: [happy]I look at my little one and my heart doesn't fit in my chest.
friend: [happy]I've made a true friend here. It changes everything.
grief: [sad]I miss them. I keep setting out one cup too many.

questions.ask: What makes you feel at home? I'd love to know.

react.food: [happy]Food! Then I'll cook for you one evening. That's a promise.
react.people: [happy]People. Yes. Walls are just walls without them.
react.fire: A warm fire. You and me both.
react.other: [happy]{answer}. I'll remember that. Maybe I can help with it.

questions.recall: You told me {answer} makes you feel at home. I thought of that today.

morning: Morning{you}. Don't stand there, say what you need.
afternoon: Afternoon. Make it quick, I've got things on.
You again{you}. Fine. What is it?
evening: Evening{you}. If you're here to chat, keep it short.
night: It's late. Go to bed. I mean it kindly.

rain: It's raining. Don't stand in it. Basic sense.
clear: Good weather. Use it. It won't last.
storm: Storm. Tie things down and stay inside. That's all the advice there is.

tired: I'm tired. Don't ask why. Just tired.
worried: [worried]Something's off. Can't put my finger on it. I don't like that.
[worried]I've got worries. I'll deal with them. I always do.
happy: Today's alright. Don't make a fuss about it.
[happy]Good day. Rare. I'm enjoying it quietly.
busy: Busy. Walk and talk or come back later.
Got a list as long as my arm. You're not on it. Yet.

stranger: Don't know you yet. That's not an insult, it's a fact.
New, are you? We'll see how you do.
friend: You're alright. I don't say that often.
I trust you. Don't make me regret it.
You turned up when it counted. I notice that sort of thing.
close: You're one of the few I'd stand beside in a fight. Take that how you like.
[happy]I'd do anything for you. Don't repeat that.
wary: [angry]I haven't forgotten. Keep your distance for a bit.

friendship: Friends are people who tell you the truth. Everyone else is just company.
I don't have many friends. The ones I have are worth it.
Took me a long time to trust anyone here. Don't waste it.
disagreements: If I've got a problem with you, you'll hear it from me. Not from behind your back.
Had words with someone last week. We sorted it. Shook hands. Done. That's how it should work.
funny: [laughing]Someone asked me to smile more. So I smiled at them until they left.
Fell in the river last week. In front of everyone. No, I don't want to talk about it.
[laughing]A child asked me why I never smile. I told them I'm saving it. They gave me a pebble 'for the savings'. Kept it.
mornings: Mornings are for getting things done before people start talking.
Up before the birds. Kettle on. Boots on. Day starts when I say it does.
evenings: Evenings I sit and don't talk. Best part of the day.
Evening means my boots come off and nobody asks me for anything. Bliss.
hopes: I hope people here learn to say what they mean. Saves time.
I'd like to grow old somewhere quiet, with people I can rely on. Might be here. Don't hold me to it.
worries: [worried]I worry the soft ones here won't cope when things get hard.
[worried]Winter. Not enough wood stacked. There's never enough wood stacked.
surprises: [surprised]Somebody thanked me today. For being honest. Didn't know what to do with my face.
[surprised]Somebody left bread on my step. No note. I know who it was. I'll pretend I don't.
village: Village is fine. People talk too much, but they work hard.
I've lived worse places. That's high praise from me.
Good people here. Soft, some of them. But good.
events: Festivals. Noise and dancing. I stand at the back and keep an eye on the fire. Someone has to.
When the monsters come, I don't hide. I grab a stick and stand at the gate. Simple.
work: Work's work. Do it properly, do it once, go home.
seasons: Every season's got a job that needs doing. That's all a season is.

gift: For me? ...Thanks. Didn't need to. Glad you did.
house: Your house is solid. That's what matters.

new_home: Got a house. Good roof. That's enough for me.
partner: Found someone who puts up with me. Doesn't happen twice.
child: I've a child now. I'll be strict. Then I'll give in. Everyone does.
friend: I've got a friend here now. Don't make a thing of it.
grief: [sad]They're gone. I don't want to talk. Just stand here a minute.

questions.ask: Straight answer. Do you prefer the truth or a kind word?

react.other: That's not an answer. But fine.

questions.recall: You said you prefer {answer}. I've been trying. Noticed?

morning: Oh! Good morning{you}. I, um, didn't see you there.
[happy]Morning... it's a nice one, isn't it? Sorry. Hello.
afternoon: H-hello{you}. Did you... want something? It's alright if you just wanted to say hi.
Oh, hello. I was hoping someone would... no, never mind. Hello.
evening: Evening{you}... I like this time. It's quieter.
Hello. It's, um, nice of you to stop.
night: Oh... you're up too? I couldn't sleep either.

rain: I like the rain... nobody minds if you stay indoors.
It's raining. The sound helps me think. Is that strange?
clear: It's so bright today. Everyone's out. It's... a lot.
[happy]Nice weather. I found a quiet spot by the trees.
storm: [worried]I don't... I don't like storms. Could you stay a minute?

tired: Sorry, I'm a bit tired. Talking takes a lot out of me.
I didn't sleep much. I kept thinking about things I said yesterday.
worried: [worried]Did I upset anyone today? I keep wondering.
[worried]I'm just... worried. It's silly. Never mind.
happy: [happy]Today's been good. Someone remembered my name.
[happy]I'm happy. Quietly. On the inside, mostly.
busy: Oh, I'm, um, a bit busy. But you can stay. If you want.

stranger: I'm... not very good at meeting people. Sorry.
Hello. I'm new. I mean, you know that. Sorry.
friend: [happy]I'm glad you talk to me. Not everyone does.
You're easy to talk to. I don't say that to many people.
close: [happy]I've never told anyone this, but you're my best friend here.
I don't feel nervous around you anymore. That's... a lot, for me.
wary: [sad]I... I'd rather not talk right now. Sorry.

work: Just working. It's nice to have something to do with my hands.
gather: Collecting things. It's quiet out here.
socialize: I'm with the others. Trying to join in.
trade: I'm trying to trade. I always agree to the first price. I know.
explore: Just walking. I like finding places no one goes.
sleep: Mm... oh! Sorry. Was I snoring? Sorry.

friendship: Making friends is hard for me. Keeping them is easier. I'm loyal.
I'd rather have one real friend than a crowd.
disagreements: I never know how to say I disagree. So I just... go quiet.
funny: [laughing]I practised saying hello to someone for an hour. Then I said 'goodbye' by mistake.
[laughing]I hid behind a tree to avoid a conversation. The tree was too thin.
[laughing]I tried to join a dance once. I bowed to the wrong partner. Then the right one. Then a fence post.
mornings: I like getting up before everyone. The village feels like mine for a little while.
evenings: Evenings I sit at the edge of the fire and listen. It's my favourite thing.
hopes: I hope one day I'll be brave enough to tell a story at the fire.
worries: [worried]I worry people only put up with me.
surprises: [surprised]Someone asked me to sit with them at lunch. On purpose!
village: People here are patient with me. I'm not used to that.
I think I could belong here. Maybe. Slowly.
events: At festivals I stand near the musicians. Nobody expects you to talk when there's music.

gift: [surprised]For me? Oh... nobody's... thank you. Really.
house: Your house is lovely. I walk past it sometimes. Not in a strange way.

new_home: [happy]My own house. With a door I can close. It's perfect.
partner: [happy]Someone likes me. For me. I still can't quite believe it.
child: [happy]My little one holds my finger when I'm nervous. Or maybe I hold theirs.
friend: [happy]I made a friend. A real one. I'm trying not to cry about it.
grief: [sad]I didn't get to say everything I wanted to. I should have been braver.

questions.ask: Do you... like quiet places? Or do you prefer busy ones?

react.quiet: [happy]Me too. Maybe I'll show you my secret spot one day.
react.busy: Oh. That's alright. You can tell me all about the busy places.
react.other: That's... a good answer. I think.

questions.recall: You said you like {answer} places. I found one I think you'd like.

morning: [laughing]Morning{you}! Isn't it wonderful? Everything is wonderful today!
[happy]Oh good, you're up! I've got about nine things to tell you.
afternoon: [happy]Hey{you}! Where've you been? I've been looking everywhere!
[laughing]There you are! Come on, come on, you'll want to hear this!
evening: [happy]Evening{you}! Fire tonight? Say yes. You're saying yes.
Oh, perfect timing! We're about to start a game. Are you in?
night: [laughing]You're awake too? Brilliant! Let's do something! Quietly! Ish!

rain: [laughing]Rain! Let's jump in puddles! No? Just me? Fine!
Rainy days are for stories and hot drinks and more stories!
clear: [happy]Sunshine! Let's race to the river! Go! ...Why aren't you running?
Beautiful day! I've already been up the hill twice!
storm: [surprised]Did you hear that thunder? It shook my teeth! Amazing! Terrifying! Amazing!

tired: [sad]I'm actually tired. It happens once a year. Today's the day.
I danced too long last night. My legs have filed a complaint.
worried: [worried]I'm trying to be cheerful but something's bothering me and I can't shake it.
[worried]Everyone's quiet today. I don't like it when everyone's quiet.
happy: [laughing]I'm SO happy! I don't even need a reason!
[happy]Best day ever! I say that a lot. It's true every time!
busy: Busy! So busy! Talk fast! Faster! Perfect!

stranger: [happy]Ooh, a new friend! I'm deciding we're friends. Done.
Hi! I don't know you yet but I already like you!
friend: [happy]You're my favourite person to tell things to!
[laughing]We should do something ridiculous together! Soon!
close: [happy]You're my best friend! I tell everyone. Even the chickens.
I'd follow you anywhere. Even somewhere boring. That's love.
wary: [angry]I'm not even going to pretend to be cheerful right now. You know why.

work: [happy]Working! Fast! I like to get it done so I can play!
gather: Gathering! I made it a race! I'm winning! Against no one!
rest: Resting! It's very hard! I keep wanting to get up!
socialize: [laughing]Talking to everyone at once! It's my favourite!
trade: Trading! I love haggling! I'm terrible at it! It's fun!
explore: Exploring! There's a hill I haven't climbed yet!
sleep: Mmf... five more minutes... is it a party? Wake me if it's a party.

friendship: [happy]The more friends the better! I want to know everyone here!
My friends are my whole world. Loud, messy, wonderful world!
disagreements: I fall out with people all the time! Then we make up! It's fine!
funny: [laughing]I tried to carry five buckets at once! It went badly! Very wet!
[laughing]I sang the wrong words to the harvest song in front of everyone! Now they're the right words!
mornings: Mornings! A whole new day! Anything can happen!
evenings: [happy]Evenings are for music! I don't play, but I clap very well!
hopes: I hope we have a festival every week! Is that too much? It's not too much!
worries: [worried]I worry I'm too loud sometimes. People would tell me, right?
surprises: [surprised]I found a frog in my boot! I've named him! He lives in my boot now!
village: [happy]I love it here! Everyone's lovely and there's always something happening!
This village is going to be famous one day! I can feel it!

gift: [happy]A present?! For me?! I love it! I love you! I mean, thank you!
house: [happy]Your house! We should have a party there! Soon!
discovery: [surprised]You found {thing}?! Take me next time! Please!

new_home: [laughing]A new house! Everyone's invited! Right now!
partner: [happy]I'm in love! I'm telling the whole village! I already told the whole village!
child: [laughing]My little one is louder than me! I'm so proud!
friend: [happy]New best friend! Well, another best friend! You can have lots!
grief: [sad]It's too quiet without them. I keep trying to fill the quiet. It doesn't work.

questions.ask: If we threw a party, what would it need? Music? Food? Dancing?

react.music: [happy]Music! I'll find someone who can play! Not me!
react.other: [laughing]{answer}! Great idea! I'd never have thought of it!

questions.recall: Remember you said a party needs {answer}? I'm planning one! Secretly! Not secretly anymore!

morning: Morning{you}... I was watching the mist leave the fields. It never says goodbye.
[happy]Oh, hello. I dreamed the river was singing. Do you think it does?
afternoon: Hello{you}. The clouds look like ships today. Look, that one's sinking.
Afternoon... is it afternoon? I lost track. I was thinking about birds.
evening: Evening{you}. The first star's out. I always make a wish. I'm not telling you which.
Hello. The sky's turning the colour of peaches. I could watch it forever.
night: [happy]You're up too? The night's so big. It makes all my worries feel small.

rain: Rain sounds like a thousand tiny stories being told at once.
I like to imagine each raindrop has travelled from the sea just to visit us.
clear: Clear skies. Tonight you'll be able to see every star. I'll count them for you.
[happy]The light today is golden. Everything looks like a memory.
storm: [surprised]A storm! The sky's having an argument with itself.

tired: I'm drifting today. Like a leaf on a pond. A tired leaf.
I stayed up looking at the moon. It was worth it. Mostly.
worried: [worried]I had an uneasy dream. I can't remember it, but the feeling stayed.
[worried]Sometimes I worry the world's moving too fast for me to notice it.
happy: [happy]I found a feather this morning, white as snow. It feels like a sign.
[happy]Today feels like the first page of a good book.
busy: I'm meant to be busy. I keep getting distracted by the sky. Sorry.

stranger: You have an interesting face. Like someone in a story I haven't read yet.
Hello, stranger. Every stranger is a door. I wonder what's behind yours.
friend: [happy]Talking to you is like sitting by still water. Peaceful.
You listen when I talk about strange things. That means a lot.
close: [happy]You're in all my best daydreams now. Is that odd? I hope it's not odd.
If I could give you one thing, it'd be the view from the hill at dawn.
wary: [sad]Something's clouded between us. I can feel it.

work: Working... slowly. I keep stopping to look at things.
gather: Gathering. I found a stone shaped like a heart. It's coming home with me.
socialize: Sitting with everyone. Listening to the sound of voices together.
trade: Trading. I always want to give things away instead.
explore: [happy]Wandering. I follow whatever path looks most like a story.
sleep: Mm... I was somewhere with tall trees made of glass... oh. Hello.

friendship: A friend is someone who lets you be strange and calls it wonderful.
I collect moments with friends the way some people collect coins.
disagreements: When people argue, I try to imagine they're both right. Sometimes they are.
funny: [laughing]I walked into a fence while watching a hawk. The hawk looked very pleased with itself.
[laughing]I talked to a goose for a long time once. It turned out to be a very still duck.
mornings: Mornings are soft. The world hasn't decided what it wants to be yet.
evenings: Evenings are when the world puts on its best colours, just before it rests.
hopes: I hope one day someone writes a song about this village. I'd hum it forever.
worries: [worried]I worry that I'll forget the small, beautiful things.
surprises: [surprised]A deer looked right at me this morning. We understood each other. I think.
village: This village feels like a place out of a lullaby.
[happy]I think this valley was waiting for us. Doesn't it feel that way?

achievement: [happy]You {thing}. That's the kind of thing people tell stories about.
gift: [surprised]A gift... I'll keep it by the window so the light can find it.
house: Your house has a good spirit. I can tell from the way the smoke curls.
discovery: [surprised]You found {thing}? Was it beautiful? It must have been.

new_home: [happy]My new home has a window facing the sunrise. I asked for that. Nobody thought I was strange.
partner: [happy]We sit and look at the stars and don't need to say anything. That's how I knew.
child: [happy]My child asked me what clouds are made of. I told them: wishes. I'm not sorry.
friend: [happy]I found someone who sees the world a bit like I do. Rare as a white crow.
grief: [sad]I look for them in the sky now. It helps, a little.

questions.ask: When you look at the night sky, what do you think about?

react.home: [sad]Home. Yes. The stars are the same everywhere. That's comforting.
react.future: [happy]The future! The sky is full of it.
react.nothing: [laughing]Nothing? That's the most peaceful answer I've ever heard.
react.other: {answer}... I'll think about that next time I look up.

questions.recall: Last night I looked up and thought about what you said. {answer}.

morning: [worried]Oh! Morning{you}. Is everything alright? Nothing's on fire? Good. Good.
Good morning. Did you hear that noise in the night? No? Just me, then.
afternoon: [worried]Hello{you}. Have I done something? You've got a face like... no? Okay. Hello.
Afternoon! Sorry. I'm a bit jumpy. Too much tea.
evening: Evening{you}. Is it getting dark early? It feels like it's getting dark early.
[worried]Hello. I've checked my door twice already tonight. Is that normal?
night: [worried]Why are you out so late? Is something wrong? Should I be worried? I'm worried.

rain: [worried]Rain. The roof held last time. It'll hold this time. Probably.
I don't mind rain. It's the flooding I mind. Not that it will flood. Will it?
clear: Nice day. Too nice? No, that's silly. It's a nice day.
[happy]Sunny and calm. I can actually relax. Briefly.
storm: [worried]Storm! Have you tied everything down? I've tied everything down. Twice.

tired: I lay awake making lists. Then I lay awake worrying about the lists.
[sad]So tired. I kept checking the fire was out. It was out. It was always out.
worried: [worried]I've been worrying all day. About what? Yes. All of it.
[worried]What if the harvest fails? What if the well runs dry? What if... sorry.
happy: [happy]I feel calm today! I don't know what to do with it!
[happy]Nothing's gone wrong all day. I'm trying to enjoy it instead of waiting for something to.
busy: [worried]So much to do. I'll never... no. I will. One thing at a time.

stranger: [worried]Hello. Sorry. I'm new and I keep thinking I'm in the way.
I'm still learning the rules here. Are there rules? Please tell me if there are rules.
friend: [happy]You make me feel less nervous. That's a real gift.
When you're around, I stop counting the things that might go wrong.
close: [happy]I trust you more than anyone. I don't even worry about it. Much.
You're my safe place. Is that too much to say? It's true.
wary: [worried]I keep thinking about what you did. I can't stop thinking about it.

work: Working. Carefully. Very carefully. I've checked it three times.
gather: Gathering. Not too far from the village. Just in case.
rest: Trying to rest. Resting is harder than it looks.
socialize: With the others. Safety in numbers, they say.
trade: [worried]Trading. Is this a fair price? It feels like a fair price. Is it?
explore: Walking. Only on paths I know.
sleep: [surprised]What? Who's there? Oh, it's you. Is everything alright? Okay. Night.

friendship: Friends are the people who tell you it'll be alright, and then help make it alright.
I used to think nobody would want a worrier for a friend. I was wrong. I'm glad.
disagreements: [worried]I hate it when people argue. I always think it's my fault, even when I wasn't there.
funny: [laughing]I once packed for a storm that never came. I had nine blankets. In summer.
[laughing]I hid from a scary noise all night. It was my own cooking pot, rattling in the wind.
mornings: Mornings are good. The night's over and nothing terrible happened.
evenings: [worried]Evenings make me think about everything I didn't finish. But the fire helps.
hopes: I hope one day I'll go a whole week without worrying. I'll throw a party. A careful one.
worries: [worried]Where do I start? The monsters. The winter. The roof. Whether people like me.
surprises: [surprised]I left my door open all day by accident and nothing happened! Nothing!
village: [happy]It's safe here. Safer than anywhere I've been. I can breathe.
People here don't laugh at my worries. They help me check the doors.

achievement: [surprised]You {thing}? Were you careful? You were careful. Wonderful!
gift: [surprised]For me? Oh, you shouldn't have. Really. But thank you. Really!
house: Your house is strong. I checked the beams. Sorry. Habit.
discovery: [worried]You found {thing}? Out there? Alone? Next time take someone!

new_home: [happy]A house with a lock. And a good roof. I slept all night for the first time in months.
partner: [happy]They don't mind my worrying. They just hold my hand until it passes.
child: [worried]I worry about my little one every minute. And love them every second.
friend: [happy]I have a friend who calms me down. I didn't know I needed that so much.
grief: [sad]I always worried I'd lose someone. It doesn't help, worrying first. It still hurts.

questions.ask: Can I ask... what scares you? It might help me feel less alone.

react.monsters: [worried]Me too. But we've got walls now. And each other.
react.dark: The dark. Yes. I keep a candle lit. I'll leave one for you too.
react.other: {answer}... thank you for telling me. I won't tell anyone.

questions.recall: You told me {answer} scares you. I've been keeping an eye out. Just for you.

morning: Morning{you}. I've finished more before breakfast than most do all day.
[happy]Ah, good morning. You've come to see good work, I hope.
afternoon: Afternoon{you}. Have you seen what I made yesterday? Everyone's talking about it.
Hello. You've caught me at my best. I'm always at my best.
evening: Evening{you}. Another fine day's work. I'd expect nothing less from myself.
Good evening. Admire the sunset. Almost as good as my craftsmanship.
night: Up late? So am I. Excellence doesn't keep regular hours.

My roof doesn't leak. I built it. Draw your own conclusions.
clear: Fine weather. The perfect day to show what I can do.
[happy]Clear sky. Everyone can see my work clearly. Good.
storm: A storm. My things are secured properly, unlike some people's.

tired: I'm tired. From doing everything twice as well as anyone else.
Even I need rest sometimes. Rarely. Today.
worried: [worried]What if someone better than me arrives? Not that it's likely. But what if?
[worried]I made a mistake today. Small. Nobody noticed. I noticed.
happy: [happy]Someone praised my work today. Rightly so. But still, it was nice.
[laughing]Today I outdid myself. Again. It's becoming a habit.
busy: Busy. Great work takes time. Mine takes slightly less.

stranger: You'll have heard of me, I expect. If not, you will.
New here? Ask anyone who does the best work. They'll point you to me.
friend: You've good taste. You keep coming back to talk to me.
[happy]I'll admit, you're more capable than I first thought.
close: [happy]You're the only one I'd let see me fail. Don't make me prove it.
Between us? You're the one person here I think might be better than me. At some things.
wary: [angry]I don't need anyone who doesn't respect me. Remember that.

gather: Gathering the finest materials. Only the finest.
socialize: Being sociable. People like hearing about my work.
trade: Trading. My goods sell themselves, really.
explore: Scouting for materials worthy of me.
sleep: ...Hm? Dreaming of a perfect joint. You've interrupted genius. Goodnight.

friendship: A friend should push you to be better. I push everyone. Some of them thank me.
I don't make friends easily. People find me intimidating. I understand why.
disagreements: When I disagree, I'm usually right. Usually. I'm working on admitting when I'm not.
funny: [laughing]I once bragged I could cross the river on a log. I could not. I said I meant to swim.
[laughing]I boasted about my soup and then served it without salt. I said it was a modern recipe.
mornings: Mornings are when the best work gets done. Mine, at least.
evenings: Evenings I look back over my work and find something to improve. There's always something.
hopes: I hope one day my name is remembered in this valley. For good work. For lasting work.
worries: [worried]I worry I'm not as good as I tell people. Don't repeat that.
surprises: [surprised]Someone made something better than mine yesterday. I asked them to teach me. That surprised us both.
village: This village is good. With my help, it'll be great.
People here work hard. Not as hard as me. But hard.

achievement: You {thing}? Impressive. I'd have done it faster, but impressive.
gift: A gift? Well. You have good taste. I'll accept it graciously.
house: Your house is decent. With a few changes I could make it excellent.
discovery: You found {thing}? I was going to find that next. Well done anyway.

new_home: [happy]My new house is the finest in the village. I'll accept compliments at any time.
partner: [happy]They think I'm wonderful. They're right. But they also love me when I'm not.
child: [happy]My child will be the finest in the valley. And if not, I'll love them the same. Obviously.
friend: I have a friend now who tells me when I'm wrong. Annoying. Valuable.
grief: [sad]All my skill and I couldn't fix this. Nothing I build will fix this.

questions.ask: What are you best at? Everyone's best at something. I'm best at most things.

react.building: Building? We'll see about that. A friendly contest one day.
react.fighting: Fighting! Useful. More useful than I'd like to admit.
react.nothing: Nothing? Nonsense. Give it time. I'll find it for you.
react.other: {answer}? Hm. I may need to learn that from you. Don't gloat.

questions.recall: You said you're best at {answer}. I've been practising it. You'll want to watch out.

morning: Morning{you}. The sun's up, so I suppose we have to be too.
Ah, another morning. They keep coming. Very persistent.
afternoon: Afternoon{you}. Halfway through the day and nothing's exploded. A triumph.
Hello. If you're looking for wisdom, you've come to the wrong person. Try the chickens.
evening: Evening{you}. The day's over. Well done us for surviving it.
Good evening. I'd say 'long day', but they're all the same length. I checked.
night: Up late? Me too. The night's the only time nobody asks me to do anything.

rain: Rain again. The sky's really committed to this.
It's raining. Good news for the plants. Bad news for my hair. Plants win.
clear: Lovely weather. I've been told to enjoy it, so I'm enjoying it. Look.
storm: Storm's coming. Remind me why we didn't build this village in a cave?

tired: I'm tired. Not from work. From being awake. Very demanding.
I'd describe my energy as 'present'. Barely.
worried: [worried]I'm worried, but in an elegant way. You can hardly tell.
[worried]Something's bothering me. I'll make a joke about it later. Not ready yet.
happy: [happy]I'm happy. Don't spread it around. I have a reputation.
[laughing]Good day. Suspiciously good. I'm keeping one eye open.
busy: Busy. Or at least, I'm making the face of a busy person. Very convincing.

stranger: New face. Welcome. Lower your expectations and you'll love it here.
Hello. I'm the one people warn you about. Mostly for the jokes.
friend: You laugh at my jokes. Either you're kind or you've got terrible taste. I'll take either.
[happy]You're alright. And I don't say that sarcastically. This time.
close: [happy]I'd tell you how much you mean to me, but I'd have to be sincere. Ugh. Fine. A lot.
You're the only one I don't make jokes around. Well, fewer jokes.
wary: [angry]I'd make a joke about what you did, but it wasn't funny.

gather: Gathering. Thrilling stuff. Please, contain your envy.
rest: Resting. I'm very good at it. Natural talent.
trade: Trading. I'm told I have an honest face. I've worked hard to hide it.
explore: Walking. Mostly to get away from the cheerful people.
sleep: ...If this isn't an emergency, I'm going to be very dry about it tomorrow.

friendship: Friends are people who know all your faults and stick around anyway. Brave souls.
I keep my friends close and my jokes closer.
disagreements: I don't argue. I just say something clever and walk away before anyone can answer.
funny: [laughing]Someone asked me to be serious for one day. I lasted until lunch. Personal best.
[laughing]I told a joke at a wedding and the goat laughed. Only the goat. I've never felt so understood.
mornings: Mornings. Nature's way of telling you the night was too short.
evenings: Evenings are good. The day can't make any more demands. Officially.
hopes: I hope one day someone finds me charming on purpose.
worries: [worried]I worry people think I don't care. I care. I just hide it under several layers of jokes.
surprises: [surprised]Someone told me I was kind today. I had to sit down.
village: It's a good village. Don't tell anyone I said that. Ruins the mystery.
Nice place. Busy. Lots of people being nice at each other. I'm adjusting.

achievement: You {thing}? Well, now I have to be impressed. How annoying.
gift: A gift? For me? Did you lose a bet? ...Thank you. Genuinely.
house: Your house is nice. It has walls and everything. Very fancy.
discovery: You found {thing}. Great. Now everyone will expect me to go exploring too.

new_home: I've got a house. Walls, roof, door. I'm practically royalty.
partner: [happy]Someone loves me. On purpose. I've checked. They're sure.
child: [laughing]I have a child. They already roll their eyes at my jokes. It's beautiful.
friend: I have a friend who laughs at all my jokes. I'm keeping them.
grief: [sad]I haven't got a joke for this. I've looked.

questions.ask: Honest question. Am I funny? You can lie. Everyone does.

react.yes: [laughing]See? I knew it. I'll be insufferable now.
react.no: [laughing]Finally, an honest answer. You're my new favourite.
react.other: That's the most diplomatic thing I've heard all week.

recall.yes: You told me I'm funny. I've been insufferable ever since. You did this.
recall.no: You told me I'm not funny. I've been working on new material. It's worse.
recall.other: I'm still thinking about whether I'm funny. Probably too much.

morning: [laughing]Morning{you}! I'm up before everyone! Well, before my parents!
[happy]Hi! Did you know frogs come out in the morning? I saw six!
afternoon: [happy]Hi{you}! Do you want to play? You can be the monster!
Hello! I'm not supposed to talk to you while I'm doing chores. But hi!
evening: [happy]Evening{you}! I get to stay up till the fire goes out tonight!
Hi! I'm meant to be going to bed soon. I'm hiding. Don't tell.
night: [surprised]Shh! I'm meant to be asleep! Are you meant to be asleep too?

rain: I'm not allowed out in the rain. I went out anyway. I'm very wet.
clear: [happy]Sunny! We're going to the river! Everyone! Probably!
It's so nice out! I'm going to climb the big tree. Don't tell anyone.
storm: [worried]The thunder's really loud. Is it going to come inside? It's not, right?

tired: [sad]I'm sleepy. But I don't want to go to bed. Bed is boring.
I played all day. My legs are noodles now.
worried: [worried]I broke something. I hid it. Will I get in trouble?
[worried]Monsters can't get in the village, can they? Promise?
happy: [laughing]I found a beetle that's GREEN! Like, really green! Best day!
[happy]I got an extra honey cake! Don't tell my brother!
busy: I'm busy! I'm building a fort! You can come in if you know the password!

stranger: Who are you? Are you new? Are you nice? You look nice.
Hi! I'm not supposed to talk to strangers. But everybody here is nice.
friend: [happy]You're my friend! Grown-up friends are the best because they're tall.
Will you play with me later? You always say yes. That's why I like you.
close: [happy]You're my best grown-up. Don't tell my parents. Well, you can tell them.
When I grow up I want to be just like you. But with a dog.
wary: [sad]I don't want to talk to you. You were mean.

work: I'm helping! I'm a very good helper. Mostly.
gather: I'm collecting stuff! Sticks, mostly! And a snail!
rest: I'm resting. Grown-ups told me to. I'm very bored.
socialize: [laughing]We're playing a game! It has no rules! I made it up!
trade: I traded a pebble for a button! I think I won!
explore: I'm exploring! I'm a famous explorer! Very famous!
sleep: Mmm... is it morning? No? ...Okay. Night night.

friendship: My best friend is a cat. And you. And everyone, really.
We made a secret club. You can join! The first rule is don't tell anyone about the club.
disagreements: I fell out with my friend because she said dragons aren't real. Dragons ARE real!
funny: [laughing]I put a frog in my bed so I'd have company! It escaped. Mum found it in the porridge!
[laughing]I tried to milk a goat. It was a boy goat. Everyone laughed for ages!
mornings: Mornings are good because there's breakfast!
evenings: The best bit of the day is stories round the fire! I know all of Sera's stories!
hopes: When I grow up I want to be a dragon. Or a builder. Probably a builder.
worries: [worried]What if I grow up and I'm boring? Grown-ups are a bit boring.
surprises: [surprised]I found a bird's egg and it HATCHED! It thinks I'm its mum!
village: This is the best village in the whole world! I've never been to another one, but I know!
I know every hiding place in the village! Well, nearly every one!
work: My job is to feed the chickens. I'm the best chicken feeder ever.
skills: I can whistle! Listen! ...Okay, almost whistle.
animals: I want a puppy so much! I'd call it Mister Paws!
I talk to the chickens. They talk back. In chicken.

achievement: [laughing]You {thing}?! That's SO cool! Can I help next time?!
gift: [surprised]For ME?! Thank you thank you thank you!
house: Your house is so cool! Can I come in? Can I?
discovery: [surprised]You found {thing}?! Was there treasure?! Was there a dragon?!

new_home: [laughing]We've got a new house! I've got my own corner!
friend: [happy]I've got a new friend! We're going to be friends forever!
grief: [sad]I miss them. Where do people go? Nobody gives me a proper answer.
child: I'm going to be a big brother or sister! I'm going to teach them everything!

questions.ask: If you could be any animal, what would you be? I'd be a dragon!

react.dragon: [laughing]A DRAGON! Same! We can be dragons together!
react.bird: A bird! You could fly over everything!
react.cat: A cat! You'd sleep all day! Lucky!
react.dog: [happy]A dog! I'd throw sticks for you!
react.horse: A horse! I'd ride you! Is that weird? That's weird.
react.other: [laughing]{answer}?! That's so silly! I love it!

questions.recall: You said you'd be a {answer}! I told everyone! They all want to be one now!
